text:
anu: quick preflight: nova13b v2 weights are at s3://redwood-models/nova/13b/v2/ (manifest at s3://redwood-models/nova/13b/v2/manifest.json, 4 shards). tokenizer blob at s3://redwood-models/nova/13b/v2/tokenizer.json
bryan: nice. checksum pass on the manifest? did onboarding script exit 0?
anu: manifest checksums match. onboarding finished with warnings only: shard-2 has mixed dtypes (fp16 + q8) due to convert heuristics. no fatal errors.
claire: tokenizer quirk: tokenizer.json sets eos_token_id=2 while runtime prefix cache expects eos=1. that mismatch causes prefix_kv misses when inputs end with EOS. prefer runtime override for canary.
sasha: agree — runtime override is lower risk. also we should cap requests for the canary to avoid kv memory spikes.
anu: proposed canary config:
```
continuous_batching:
  max_batch_size: 80
  max_tokens: 512
  batch_timeout_ms: 4
  adaptive_batching: true
cache_policy:
  prefix_kv_enabled: true
  prefix_kv_ttl_secs: 900
  prefetch_window_tokens: 32
scheduler:
  prefetch_tokens: 64
  window_ms: 30
max_request_tokens: 2048
logging:
  emit_batch_occupancy: true
  emit_batch_wait_ms: true
```
bryan: two asks:
- keep max_request_tokens=2048 for canary.
- ensure runtime quant path fully supports the mixed-dtype shard layout; otherwise expect fallback and latency spikes.
claire: pushed a small metadata override to S3: s3://redwood-models/nova/13b/v2/metadata_overrides.json with `tokenizer_overrides:{"eos_token_id":1}` and a unit test that tokenizes 30 sample prefixes.
sasha: scheduler change noted; i'm going to use rg-canary-3 with window_ms=30 and prefetch_tokens=64. i'll watch kv_cache_mem and prefix_hit_ratio.
deploybot: rollout plan queued: nova13b-v2-canary -> rg-canary-3 (5 nodes). config rev r504, scheduled start 2149999999. monitor: https://console.redwood/internal/rollouts/nova13b-v2-canary
anu: initiating 30m observation once deploy starts. target p95 < 1200ms.
bryan: add metrics and alarms: batch_occupancy, batch_wait_ms, kv_cache_mem_bytes, prefix_hit_ratio. if kv_cache_mem > 70% budget, flip prefix_kv_enabled=false and notify.
claire: ran local smoke: `rictl model validate --weights s3://redwood-models/nova/13b/v2/manifest.json --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/nova/13b/v2/tokenizer.json --config configs/nova13b-canary.json` — override applied, tokenization sanity ok, prefix hit ~18% with TTL=900.
sasha: will stand by for mem alerts. if needed, i'll disable prefix cache and post timings.
anu: can people +1 to proceed? plan: 30m then report back.
bryan: +1 :thumbsup:
claire: +1
sasha: +1 — watching metrics, ready to rollback
deploybot: canary nodes reporting healthy: 5/5 at 2149990200
anu: thanks — observing and will share perf snapshot at end of window. :v
